LanguageData.LP_WS_ForceWall.label: wall of force
LanguageData.LP_WS_ForceWall.description: A transparent force field conjured by a wizard that blocks bullets and melee, dissipating after a while.
LanguageData.LP_WS_TeleportCircle.label: teleportation circle
LanguageData.LP_WS_TeleportCircle.description: A permanent teleportation circle (3×3) carved by a wizard. When a wizard casts "teleportation circle" on it, the people and things on its 3×3 are sent to another teleportation circle (the main base's preferred).
